senses.gloss:
f. always dual, (-मे)
Heaven and earth.
E.
द्यौ heaven, क्षमा the earth, form irr.; also similar compounds, as द्यावापृथिवी, द्यावाभूमी, &c.

f. always dual, (-व्यौ)
Heaven and earth.
E.
द्यौ heaven, and पृथिवी the earth: see the preceding.

f. always dual. (-म्यौ)
Heaven and earth.
E.
द्यौ, and भूमी the earth: see the two words preceding.
